Descriptions reflect inspected artwork. Science diagrams are symbolic embroidery, not calibrated technical schematics or assertions that a named scientist personally used every pictured device. Related earlier publications can supply the scientific background of later apparatus; the border introduces no new dated events. Exact prompts and both supplied references are maintained separately. Pixel hashes record the inspected RGB crop data; source and geometry hashes detect changes. Visual review must still assess repeated compositions and accuracy. A second set of six continuation atlases supplies 48 additional distinct ribbons. Four different whole ribbons now run end-to-end on each side of each chronological section. Frame sizing fits native source aspect ratios into the shared context height; no horizontal spacer is permitted. The early continuation has a small lodestone correction; the uncorrected edit target and exact correction prompt are retained. Active masters contain transparent threadwork on a shared linen backing.
